title: Wizards Play Network 2024: card flavor text

entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: A being whose name is used for a deck by an unnamed player excited about a Tide Shaper.

entities.name: Tide Shaper
entities.description: A card or creature that a player is excited to put into a Svyelun deck.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A figure whose will of stone no iron lock can match; she speaks of having seen things that would break a weaker person.

entities.name: Joskun
entities.description: An An-Havva constable who insists there are no monsters in the forest, only squirrels.

entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: The place where Joskun serves as constable.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm from which demons poured into Bretagard.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: A land invaded by the demons of Immersturm.

events.summary: Demons of Immersturm pour into Bretagard, slaughtering as they come and spreading panic.
events.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

relations.note: Joskun is a constable of An-Havva.
